title: Cross-module call
description: One module's call to another provider's module, through the platform, and the platform's record of it (REQ-MDL-21, THR-86). It names the route segment that declares the call; the platform makes it only when that route names it and the caller declares it. The callee receives a provider-role operation, answers it as any other, and acts on its own credentials: the call carries none. Its outcome says whether the callee answered it (delivered), the platform passed it on and no answer came (unanswered), or the platform refused it, so a refused or unanswered call is recorded too. A call is recorded as delivered only when its callee answered.

transaction.description: The transaction the call is made for (REQ-MDL-8). The callee's operation names the same one, unless it is a judgement question, which names none (REQ-CPL-4).

operation.description: What is asked of the callee, as a provider-role operation; its provider is the callee.

route_reference.description: The route decision record, and the segment in it, that names this call.

outcome.description: Delivered to the callee, which answered; passed on with no answer; or refused by the platform, naming the callee, the kind asked and why.

delivered.description: The platform passed the call on and the callee answered it.

unanswered.description: The platform passed the call on and no answer came: the callee stopped, was stopped by a limit or a deadline, or gave no answer the platform could read. What the callee did is not known, so it is not recorded as delivered.

refused.description: A refused call: the platform passed nothing on. Its callee and kind are the operation's; that is checked in Rust, not by this schema. Whether the reason is true of the caller's declaration is checked in Rust against that declaration.
